**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW), confidence 0.9**

What I found:
- **§ 11 (p0043)** selects **Arizona law** — outside the accepted list (NY, DE, CA, England & Wales) — and names no court venue.
- **§ 19 (p0053–p0056)** mandates **binding arbitration** of all disputes under U.S. Arbitration & Mediation rules, contrary to our courts-not-arbitration position. The seat is domestic, so this is a medium deviation rather than a walk-away.

Redline (validated ok:true, preferred level):
1. p0043 — "laws of the **Arizona**" → "laws of the **State of New York**", plus an added exclusive-jurisdiction sentence for the state and federal courts in New York County.
2. p0053 — heading "19. Arbitration." → "19. Disputes; Venue."
3. p0056 — arbitration forum language replaced with exclusive jurisdiction of the New York County state and federal courts, keeping the Disputes definition and signature text untouched.

The comment notes Delaware or California law and courts as an acceptable fallback.
